refuter_findings.location: Definition, paragraph beginning “Fix a translation-invariant unit vector”
refuter_findings.evidence: The Definition requires “a specified unital $*$-subalgebra $[0m\mathfrak A\subseteq\mathcal B(\mathcal H)$” but does not state the inherited operations or the conditions that make this subset a unital $*$-subalgebra. The related `def-qft-involutive-algebra-state` defines an abstract unital complex star algebra, but is neither a dependency nor a reference and does not define this concrete subalgebra condition.

The proof says “Let $K\subset V_+$ be compact and set $\delta_K:=\min_{b\in K}(b^0-|\mathbf b|)>0$.” Compact subsets may be empty, in which case this minimum is undefined. The later application uses a singleton, so requiring nonempty $K$ repairs the gap.
